newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan cotton rates unchanged on select buying.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan cotton rates unchanged on select buying.

text.p: Pakistan cotton rates remained unchanged on Wednesday on select buying, but dealers said most deals were done on credit as mill owners were short of cash.

"Mill owners are short of cash because of depressed yarn sales and most deals were made on credit," dealer Naseem Usman said. "The rates will remain stuck to these levels in the coming weeks as the arrival of new crop (1997/98) might be delayed.
In the kerb, NIAB-78 variety was quoted at between 1,900 rupees ($47.24) to 2,100 rupees per maund (37.32 kg) and MNH-93 at 1,800 to 2,250, dealers said.
